# EnterpriseGlue v0.40.12 Release Notes

Generated from release-note fragments changed since `v0.40.11`.

## Highlights

- **frontend:** Starts workspace session checks while the dashboard downloads and loads secondary screens on demand.

## User and administrator impact

- The dashboard can fetch project data as soon as the browser verifies the session. Engine and process information continue to load independently.

## Database migrations

- Database rollback supported for the combined release: yes.

## Security

- Early reads use the existing session transport and are accepted only for the current browser session.

## Documentation

- Release notes describe the earlier session checks and on-demand screens.
